 function(text)
            if Tr.probe() then
                local out = Tr.roblox(text, Tr.lang)
                if out and out ~= "" then return out, nil end
            end
            return Tr.google(text, Tr.lang)
        end
        Tr.trim = function(s) return (tostring(s or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")) end
        Tr.batch = function(list)
            local res = {}
            if not Tr.probe() and #list > 1 then
                local joined = Tr.google(table.concat(list, "\n"), Tr.lang)
                if not joined then return res end
                do
                    local parts = {}
                    for line in (joined .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do parts[#parts + 1] = Tr.trim(line) end
                    if #parts == #list then
                        for i, s in ipairs(list) do res[s] = parts[i] end
                        return res
                    end
                end
            end
            for i, s in ipairs(list) do
                res[s] = (Tr.one(s))
                if i < #list then task.wait(0.1) end
            end
            return res
        end
        Tr.want = function(key, cb)
            local c = Tr.cache[key]
            if c then cb(c) return end
            local w = Tr.waiters[key]
            if w then table.insert(w, cb) return end
            Tr.waiters[key] = {cb}
            table.insert(Tr.queue, key)
            Tr.kick()
        end
        Tr.kick = function()
            if Tr.running then return end
            Tr.running = true
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(0.3)
                while #Tr.queue > 0 and ScreenGui.Parent do
                    local list, size = {}, 0
                    while #Tr.queue > 0 and #list < 25 and (#list == 0 or size + #Tr.queue[1] < 1200) do
                        local k = table.remove(Tr.queue, 1)
                        list[#list + 1] = k
                        size += #k + 1
                    end
                    local res = Tr.batch(list)
                    local anyOk = false
                    for _, k in ipairs(list) do
                        local v = res[k]
                        if type(v) == "string" and v ~= "" then
                            Tr.cache[k] = v
                            anyOk = true
                        end
                        Tr.tries[k] = (Tr.tries[k] or 0) + 1
                        if Tr.cache[k] or Tr.tries[k] >= 3 then
                            local w = Tr.waiters[k]
                            Tr.waiters[k] = nil
                            for _, cb in ipairs(w or {}) do pcall(cb, Tr.cache[k]) end
                        else
                            table.insert(Tr.queue, k)
                        end
                    end
                    if anyOk then Tr.save() else task.wait(8) end
                    task.wait(0.2)
                end
                Tr.running = false
            end)
        end
        Tr.convert = function(src, cb)
            local pieces, pos = {}, 1
            while pos <= #src do
                local a, b = src:find("<[^<>]->", pos)
                if not a then
                    pieces[#pieces + 1] = {t = src:sub(pos)}
                    break
                end
                if a > pos then pieces[#pieces + 1] = {t = src:sub(pos, a - 1)} end
                pieces[#pieces + 1] = {tag = src:sub(a, b)}
                pos = b + 1
            end
            local pending = 1
            local function done()
                pending -= 1
                if pending > 0 then return end
                local out = {}
                for _, p in ipairs(pieces) do out[#out + 1] = p.tag or p.out or p.t end
                cb(table.concat(out))
            end
            for _, p in ipairs(pieces) do
                if p.t then
                    local lead, core, trail = p.t:match("^(%s*)(.-)(%s*)$")
                    if core:find("%a") then
                        local nums = {}
                        local key = core:gsub("%d+", function(n)
                            nums[#nums + 1] = n
                            return "0"
                        end)
                        pending += 1
                        Tr.want(key, function(v)
                            if type(v) == "string" then
                                local i = 0
                                local filled = v:gsub("%d+", function()
                                    i += 1
                                    return nums[i]
                                end)
                                if i == #nums then p.out = lead .. filled .. trail end
                            end
                            done()
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            done()
        end
        Tr.apply = function(obj, prop)
            if not obj.Parent or obj:GetAttribute("NoTr") then return end
            local cur = obj[prop]
            if type(cur) ~= "string" or cur == "" or not cur:find("%a") then return end
            local mine = Tr.setByMe[obj]
            if mine and mine[prop] == cur then return end
            Tr.convert(cur, function(out)
                if out ~= cur and obj[prop] == cur and obj.Parent and not obj:GetAttribute("NoTr") then
                    Tr.setByMe[obj] = Tr.setByMe[obj] or {}
                    Tr.setByMe[obj][prop] = out
                    obj[prop] = out
                end
            end)
        end
        Tr.hook = function(obj)
            local props = Tr.props[obj.ClassName]
            if not props or Tr.hooked[obj] then return end
            Tr.hooked[obj] = true
            for _, prop in ipairs(props) do
                obj:GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop):Connect(function() Tr.apply(obj, prop) end)
                Tr.apply(obj, prop)
            end
        end
        Tr.watch = function(root)
            for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do Tr.hook(d) end
            root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
                task.defer(function()
                    if d.Parent then Tr.hook(d) end
                end)
            end)
        end
        Tr.msgFor = function(src, cb)
            local c = Tr.msgCache[src]
            if c ~= nil then cb(c or nil) return end
            local w = Tr.msgWait[src]
            if w then table.insert(w, cb) return end
            Tr.msgWait[src] = {cb}
            table.insert(Tr.msgQueue, src)
            if Tr.msgRunning then return end
            Tr.msgRunning = true
            task.spawn(function()
                while #Tr.msgQueue > 0 and ScreenGui.Parent do
                    local s = table.remove(Tr.msgQueue, 1)
                    local out, from = Tr.one(s)
                    local res = nil
                    if out ~= nil then
                        res = false
                        local same = string.lower((Tr.trim(out):gsub("%s+", " "))) == string.lower((Tr.trim(s):gsub("%s+", " ")))
                        if out ~= "" and not same and (from == nil or Tr.base(from) ~= Tr.base(Tr.lang)) then res = out end
                        Tr.msgCache[s] = res
                    end
                    local list = Tr.msgWait[s]
                    Tr.msgWait[s] = nil
                    for _, f in ipairs(list or {}) do pcall(f, res or nil) end
                    task.wait(out == nil and 3 or 0.15)
                end
                Tr.msgRunning = false
            end)
        end
        Tr.message = function(meta)
            if type(meta) ~= "table" or meta.isMe or meta.trReq or not meta.trBody or type(meta.trSrc) ~= "string" then return end
            if not meta.trSrc:find("%a") then return end
            meta.trReq = true
            Tr.msgFor(meta.trSrc, function(out)
                if not out or not meta.row or not meta.row.Parent or messageRows[meta.key] ~= meta then return end
                local nearBottom = Chat.isNearBottom()
                meta.trOut = out
                meta.trShown = true
                meta.trBody(out)
                local btn = mk("TextButton", {
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = "Traducido · Ver original", TextColor3 = THEME.DIM, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12,
                    AutoButtonColor = false, LayoutOrder = 5,
                }, meta.content)
                mk("UIPadding", {PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)}, btn)
                meta.trBtn = btn
                btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    meta.trShown = not meta.trShown
                    meta.trBody(meta.trShown and meta.trOut or meta.trSrc)
                    btn.Text = meta.trShown and "Traducido · Ver original" or "Ver traducción"
                end)
                if nearBottom then task.defer(scrollBottom) end
            end)
        end
        if Tr.uiOn then
            Tr.watch(ScreenGui)
            Tr.watch(Surface)
        end
        for _, meta in pairs(messageRows) do Tr.message(meta) end
    end
    Chat.applyView()
    Chat.refreshHome(true)
    task.spawn(function() pcall(Chat.refreshPresence) end)
    Chat.layoutHost()
    return {
        Chat = Chat,
        SetHeaderInset = function(inset)
            inset = math.max(0, tonumber(inset) or 0)
            Header.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(inset, 0)
            Header.Size = UDim2.new(1, -inset, 0, 58)
        end,
        GetSideNotifs = function() return Chat.settings.SideNotifs ~= false end,
        SetSideNotifs = function(v)
            Chat.settings.SideNotifs = v and true or false
            Chat.saveSettings()
            if not v and UI.SideHolder then
                for _, c in ipairs(UI.SideHolder:GetChildren()) do
                    if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
                end
            end
        end,
        Destroy = function()
            generation += 1
            pcall(function() ScreenGui:Destroy() end)
            pcall(function() Surface:Destroy() end)
        end,
    }
end


function YinYang:GetLanguage()
    return LibraryLanguage
end

function YinYang:GetLanguageMode()
    return YLang.Mode
end

function YinYang:SetLanguageMode(mode)
    return YLang.SetMode(mode)
end

function YinYang:OnLanguageChanged(callback)
    if type(callback) == "function" then
        table.insert(YLang.Listeners, callback)
    end
end

function YinYang:CreateWindow(title_text, startTheme, options)
    options = type(options) == "table" and options or {}
    startTheme = startTheme or "Senju"
    -- Halloween terminado: Dark queda bloqueado; si la config guardada lo trae se usa Senju
    if startTheme == "Dark" and ThemePalettes["Senju"] then startTheme = "Senju" end

    if IsPlayerBanned(LocalPlayer) then
        pcall(function()
            if LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("ZeroMobile") then
                LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.ZeroMobile:Destroy()
            end
        end)
        warn("[ZeroLib] Acceso denegado: " .. tostring(LocalPlayer.Name))
        local dummy = {}
        setmetatable(dummy, {
            __index = function(_, _)
                return function() return dummy end
            end
        })
        return dummy
    end

    local ConfigCargada = LoadConfig()
    if ConfigCargada then
        if ConfigCargada.libMode then
            SavedConfig.LibrarySizeMode = ConfigCargada.libMode
        end
        if ConfigCargada.libHeight then
            SavedConfig.LibraryHeight = ConfigCargada.libHeight
        end
        if ConfigCargada.effect then
            SavedConfig.CurrentEffect = ConfigCargada.effect
        end
        if ConfigCargada.volume then
            SavedConfig.Volume = ConfigCargada.volume
        end
        if ConfigCargada.hideSliders ~= nil then
            SavedConfig.HideSliders = ConfigCargada.hideSliders
        end
        if ConfigCargada.favorites then
            SavedConfig.Favorites = ConfigCargada.favorites
        end
        if type(ConfigCargada.spotifyFavorites) == "table" then
            SavedConfig.SpotifyFavorites = ConfigCargada.spotifyFavorites
        end
        if ConfigCargada.logoIcon then
            SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon = ConfigCargada.logoIcon
        end
        if ConfigCargada.platformMode then
            SavedConfig.PlatformMode = ConfigCargada.platformMode
        end
        if ConfigCargada.floatStyle then
            SavedConfig.FloatingToggleStyle = ConfigCargada.floatStyle
        end
        if ConfigCargada.tabIconLayout == "Carousel" or ConfigCargada.tabIconLayout == "Original" then
            SavedConfig.TabIconLayout = ConfigCargada.tabIconLayout
        end
        if ConfigCargada.chatCorner ~= nil then
            SavedConfig.ChatCornerMessages = ConfigCargada.chatCorner
        end
        if ConfigCargada.keybinds then
            SavedConfig.Keybinds = ConfigCargada.keybinds
        end
    end

    local SlidersHidden = SavedConfig.HideSliders or false

    local SavedFavoriteIds = {}
    for id in (SavedConfig.Favorites or ""):gmatch("([^,]+)") do
        SavedFavoriteIds[id] = true
    end
    local AutoTabFavoritosRef = nil

    local function SyncFavoritesToConfig()
        local ids = {}
        for id, isFav in pairs(SavedFavoriteIds) do
            if isFav then table.insert(ids, id) end
        end
        SavedConfig.Favorites = table.concat(ids, ",")
        SaveConfig()
    end

    setActiveTheme(startTheme)

    local globalConnections = {}
    local function track(conn)
        for i = #globalConnections, 1, -1 do
            local existing = globalConnections[i]
            if not existing.Connected then
                table.remove(globalConnections, i)
            end
        end
        table.insert(globalConnections, conn)
        return conn
    end

    local guiParent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    pcall(function()
        if typeof(gethui) == "function" then
            local hiddenUi = gethui()
            if hiddenUi then guiParent = hiddenUi end
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local previous = guiParent:FindFirstChild("ZeroMobile")
        if previous then previous:Destroy() end
    end)

    local ScreenGui = mk("ScreenGui", {
        Name = "ZeroMobile",
        ResetOnSpawn = false,
        IgnoreGuiInset = true,
        DisplayOrder = 2147483647,
        ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global,
    }, guiParent)

    pcall(function() ScreenGui.AutoLocalize = false end)
    pcall(function() ScreenGui.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.None end)
    pcall(function() ScreenGui.ClipToDeviceSafeArea = false end)
    pcall(function() ScreenGui.SafeAreaCompatibility = Enum.SafeAreaCompatibility.FullscreenExtension end)
    pcall(function()
        if typeof(protect_gui) == "function" then protect_gui(ScreenGui) end
    end)

    local ToggleButton = mk("TextButton", {
        Name = "ToggleButton",
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 42),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 70),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
        Text = "",
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize = 17,
        ZIndex = 30,
    }, ScreenGui)
    ToggleButton:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
    corner(ToggleButton, 999)
    stroke(ToggleButton, Theme.Accent, 1.5)


    local function lerpN(a, b, t) return a + (b - a) * t end

    local logoLayers   = {}
    local logoIdleConn = nil
    local logoRenderConn = nil
    local toggleEyesOnClick = nil

    local resolveLogoClickSound
    do
        local resolved = {}
        resolveLogoClickSound = function(iconName, clickS, allowDownload)
            local url = clickS and clickS.Url
            if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then return nil end

            local cacheName = clickS.CacheName
            if type(cacheName) ~= "string" or cacheName == "" then
                cacheName = "YinYang_IconClick_" .. tostring(iconName) .. ".mp3"
            end

            if resolved[cacheName] then return resolved[cacheName] end
            if not getcustomasset then return nil end

            local exists = false
            if isfile then
                local okFile, resultFile = pcall(function() return isfile(cacheName) end)
                exists = okFile and resultFile == true
            end

            if not exists then
                if not allowDownload or not writefile then return nil end

                local okDownload, data = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url, true) end)
                if not okDownload or type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 10 then
                    warn("[YinYang Icons] Falló la descarga del sonido (" .. url .. "): " .. tostring(data))
                    return nil
                end

                local okWrite = pcall(function() writefile(cacheName, data) end)
                if not okWrite then
                    warn("[YinYang Icons] Falló writefile para el sonido: " .. cacheName)
                    return nil
                end
            end

            local okAsset, asset = pcall(function() return getcustomasset(cacheName) end)
            if okAsset and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
                resolved[cacheName] = asset
                return asset
            end
            return nil
        end
    end

    local function ApplyLogoIcon(iconName)
        if logoRenderConn then logoRenderConn:Disconnect(); logoRenderConn = nil end
        if logoIdleConn   then logoIdleConn:Disconnect();   logoIdleConn   = nil end

        for _, entry in ipairs(logoLayers) do
            if entry.label and entry.label.Parent then
                entry.label:Destroy()
            end
        end
        logoLayers = {}

        stopGlowTweens(tostring(ToggleButton))
        local _cs = ToggleButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if _cs then
            local _cg = _cs:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
            if _cg then _cg:Destroy() end
            _cs.Transparency = 0
            _cs.Color        = Theme.Accent
            _cs.Thickness    = 1.5
        end
        ToggleButton:SetAttribute("IsCapsule", false)
        ToggleButton.Size             = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 42)
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
        ToggleButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0
        do
            local _resetCorner = ToggleButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
            if _resetCorner then _resetCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 999) end
        end

        local iconData = IconCatalog.Icons[iconName]
            or IconCatalog.Icons["ClassicYinYang"]
        if not iconData then return end

        if iconData.ClickSound and type(iconData.ClickSound.Url) == "string" and iconData.ClickSound.Url ~= "" then
            task.spawn(resolveLogoClickSound, iconName, iconData.ClickSound, true)
        end

        if iconData.Type == "Capsule" then
            ToggleButton:SetAttribute("IsCapsule", true)
            ToggleButton.Size             = UDim2.fromOffset(185, 42)
            ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24)
            ToggleButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15

            do
                local _capCorner = ToggleButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
                if _capCorner then _capCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14) end
            end

            local arrowImg = mk("ImageLabel", {
                Parent                 = ToggleButton,
                Size                   = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26),
                Position               = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -13),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Image                  = "rbxassetid://89220810765334",
                ImageColor3            = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
                ZIndex                 = 31,
            })
            table.insert(logoLayers, { label = arrowImg, def = {}, state = {} })

            local divider = mk("Frame", {
                Parent           = ToggleButton,
                Size             = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 20),
                Position         = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0.5, -10),
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 100),
                BorderSizePixel  = 0,
                ZIndex           = 31,
            })
            table.insert(logoLayers, { label = divider, def = {}, state = {} })

            local textLbl = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent                 = ToggleButton,
                Size                   = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0),
                Position               = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text                   = "Open YinYang",
                TextColor3             = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
                Font                   = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize               = 16,
                TextXAlignment         = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                ZIndex                 = 31,
            })
            table.insert(logoLayers, { label = textLbl, def = {}, state = {} })

            do
                local _key = tostring(ToggleButton)
                stopGlowTweens(_key)

                local _capStroke = ToggleButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if _capStroke then
                    local _oldGrad = _capStroke:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
                    if _oldGrad then _oldGrad:Destroy() end
                    _capStroke.Thickness    = 3
                    _capStroke.Color        = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    _capStroke.Transparency = 0
                    _capStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
                    _capStroke.LineJoinMode    = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round

                    local _capsulePulse = TweenService:Create(
                        _capStroke,
                        TweenInfo.new(1.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
                        { Transparency = 0.15 }
                    )
                    _capsulePulse:Play()

                    local _bandA = mk("Frame", {
                        Parent = ToggleButton,
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        ZIndex = 40,
                    })
                    corner(_bandA, 14)
                    local _bandAStroke = mk("UIStroke", {
                        Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
                        Thickness = 3,
                        Transparency = 0,
                        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
                        LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round,
                    }, _bandA)
                    local _gradA = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                    _gradA.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0))
                    _gradA.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, 1),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, 1),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, 0.15),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, 1),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, 1),
                    })
                    _gradA.Offset = Vector2.new(-1.5, 0)
                    _gradA.Parent = _bandAStroke
                    local _sweepA = TweenService:Create(
                        _gradA,
                        TweenInfo.new(2.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, false),
                        { Offset = Vector2.new(1.5, 0) }
                    )
                    _sweepA:Play()
                    table.insert(logoLayers, { label = _bandA, def = {}, state = {} })

                    local _bandB = mk("Frame", {
                        Parent = ToggleButton,
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        ZIndex = 40,
                    })
                    corner(_bandB, 14)
                    local _bandBStroke = mk("UIStroke", {
                        Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
                        Thickness = 3,
                        Transparency = 0,
                        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
                        LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round,
                    }, _bandB)
                    local _gradB = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                    _gradB.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0))
                    _gradB.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, 1),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, 1),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, 0.15),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, 1),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, 1),
                    })
                    _gradB.Offset = Vector2.new(1.5, 0)
                    _gradB.Parent = _bandBStroke
                    local _sweepB = TweenService:Create(
                        _gradB,
                        TweenInfo.new(2.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, false),
                        { Offset = Vector2.new(-1.5, 0) }
                    )
                    _sweepB:Play()
                    table.insert(logoLayers, { label = _bandB, def = {}, state = {} })

                    ActiveGlowTweens[_key] = { _capsulePulse, _sweepA, _sweepB }
                end
            end
            return
        end

        if type(iconData.Build) == "function" then
            local _bs = ToggleButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
            ToggleButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 56)
            ToggleButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            if _bs then _bs.Transparency = 1 end

            local _holder = mk("Frame", {
                Parent                 = ToggleButton,
                Size                   = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ZIndex                 = 31,
            })
            local _bOk, _bRes = pcall(iconData.Build, { Parent = _holder, Button = ToggleButton })
            if _bOk then
                table.insert(logoLayers, {
                    label   = _holder,
                    def     = {},
                    state   = {},
                    onClick = (type(_bRes) == "table") and _bRes.OnClick or nil,
                })
                return
            end

            print("[YinYang Icons] ⚠️ Build falló, se usa Layers: " .. tostring(_bRes))
            _holder:Destroy()
            ToggleButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 42)
            ToggleButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            if _bs then _bs.Transparency = 0 end
        end

        if not iconData.Layers then return end

        -- NoBackground = true (catalogo de iconos): solo se ve la imagen, sin el circulo de color
        -- del tema ni el borde del boton. Ambos se restauran al inicio de ApplyLogoIcon al cambiar de icono.
        if iconData.NoBackground == true then
            local _nbStroke = ToggleButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
            ToggleButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            if _nbStroke then _nbStroke.Transparency = 1 end
        end
        -- BgColor / BorderColor (logos propios del Estudio de logos): colores fijos en vez del Accent del tema.
        -- Los íconos del catálogo no los traen, así que para ellos no cambia nada.
        if iconData.NoBackground ~= true then
            if typeof(iconData.BgColor) == "Color3" then
                ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = iconData.BgColor
            end
            if typeof(iconData.BorderColor) == "Color3" then
                local _bcStroke = ToggleButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if _bcStroke then _bcStroke.Color = iconData.BorderColor end
            end
        end

        for i, layerDef in ipairs(iconData.Layers) do
            local sc = layerDef.Scale or 1.6
            local off = -((sc - 1) / 2)
            local label
            local spriteState = nil

            if type(layerDef.SpriteSheet) == "table" then
                label, spriteState = createSpriteSheetLabels(
                    ToggleButton,
                    layerDef.SpriteSheet,
                    UDim2.new(sc, 0, sc, 0),
                    UDim2.new(off, 0, off, 0),
                    30 + i
                )
            else
                label = mk("ImageLabel", {
                    Parent               = ToggleButton,
                    Size                 = UDim2.new(sc, 0, sc, 0),
                    Position             = UDim2.new(off, 0, off, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Image                = layerDef.Image or "",
                    ZIndex                = 30 + i,
                })
            end

            if not label then
                continue
            end

            -- Color / Transparency por capa (logos propios); las capas del catálogo no los traen
            if label:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                if typeof(layerDef.Color) == "Color3" then
                    label.ImageColor3 = layerDef.Color
                end
                if tonumber(layerDef.Transparency) then
                    label.ImageTransparency = math.clamp(tonumber(layerDef.Transparency), 0, 1)
                end
            end

            mk("UIAspectRatioConstraint", { AspectRatio = 1 }, label)

            local state = {
                angle       = 0,
                speed       = layerDef.Speed or 60,
                tSpeed      = layerDef.Speed or 60,
                time        = 0,
                turboEndTime = 0,
                turboSpeed   = layerDef.TurboSpeed or 350,
                sprite      = spriteState,
            }
            table.insert(logoLayers, { label = label, def = layerDef, state = state })
        end

        logoRenderConn = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if PerfOpt.Flags.NoLogoAnim then return end
            for _, entry in ipairs(logoLayers) do
                local lbl = entry.label
                local def = entry.def
                local st  = entry.state
                if not lbl or not lbl.Parent then continue end

                local mv  = def.Movement  or "None"
                local spd = def.Speed     or 60
                local amt = def.Amount    or 0
                local dir = def.Direction or 1

                st.time = st.time + dt

                if st.sprite then
                    local sprite = st.sprite
                    sprite.Acc = sprite.Acc + dt
                    local step = 1 / sprite.Config.FPS
                    if sprite.Acc > 0.25 then
                        sprite.Acc = 0.25
                    end
                    local moved = false
                    while sprite.Acc >= step do
                        sprite.Acc = sprite.Acc - step
                        sprite.Frame = (sprite.Frame + 1) % sprite.Config.TotalFrames
                        moved = true
                    end
                    if moved then
                        updateSpriteSheetFrame(sprite, sprite.Frame)
                    end
                end

                if mv == "Spin" then
                    local now    = os.clock()
                    local inTurbo = st.turboEndTime > 0 and now < st.turboEndTime

                    if inTurbo then
                        st.speed  = st.turboSpeed
                        st.tSpeed = st.turboSpeed
                    else
                        if (def.Style or "Constant") == "Organic" then
                            st.tSpeed = spd + math.sin(st.time * 0.8) * (spd * 0.33)
                            st.speed  = lerpN(st.speed, st.tSpeed, 0.08)
                        else
                            st.speed = spd
                        end
                    end
                    st.angle = st.angle + st.speed * dir * dt
                    lbl.Rotation = st.angle

                elseif mv == "Pulse" then
                    local sc    = def.Scale or 1.6
                    local off   = -((sc - 1) / 2)
                    local scale = 1 + math.sin(st.time * (2 * math.pi / spd)) * ((amt ~= 0 and amt or 12) / 100)
                    lbl.Size     = UDim2.new(sc * scale, 0, sc * scale, 0)
                    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(off * scale, 0, off * scale, 0)

                elseif mv == "Orbit" then
                    local sc     = def.Scale or 1.6
                    local off    = -((sc - 1) / 2)
                    local radius = amt ~= 0 and amt or 6
                    local angle  = st.time * math.rad(spd) * dir
                    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(off, math.cos(angle) * radius, off, math.sin(angle) * radius)

                elseif m
v == "Float" then
                    local sc  = def.Scale or 1.6
                    local off = -((sc - 1) / 2)
                    local oy  = math.sin(st.time * (2 * math.pi / spd)) * (amt ~= 0 and amt or 4)
                    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(off, 0, off, oy)

                elseif mv == "Shake" then
                    local sc        = def.Scale or 1.6
                    local off       = -((sc - 1) / 2)
                    local intensity = amt ~= 0 and amt or 2
                    local ox = math.sin(st.time * spd * math.pi * 2 + 0.3) * intensity
                    local oy = math.cos(st.time * spd * math.pi * 2) * intensity
                    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(off, ox, off, oy)

                elseif mv == "Fade" then
                    local maxAlpha = math.clamp(amt ~= 0 and amt or 0.6, 0, 1)
                    lbl.ImageTransparency = ((math.sin(st.time * (2 * math.pi / spd)) + 1) / 2) * maxAlpha
                end
            end
        end)

        local idleS = iconData.IdleSound
        if idleS and type(idleS.Id) == "string" and idleS.Id ~= "" then
            local interval = idleS.Interval or 15
            local elapsed  = 0
            logoIdleConn = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                if elapsed >= interval then
                    elapsed = 0
                    if not Main or not Main.Visible then
                        playSound(idleS.Id, idleS.Volume or 0.15)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        if iconData.Eyes then
            local eyeData  = iconData.Eyes
            local eyeSize  = eyeData.Size  or 0.09
            local eyeColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            local eyeZIndex = 38

            local function makeEye(xRel, yRel)
                local eye = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = ToggleButton,
                    Size = UDim2.new(eyeSize, 0, eyeSize, 0),
                    Position = UDim2.new(xRel - eyeSize/2, 0, yRel - eyeSize/2, 0),
                    BackgroundColor3 = eyeColor,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ZIndex = eyeZIndex,
                })
                local uc = Instance.new("UICorner")
                uc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
                uc.Parent = eye

                local glow = Instance.new("UIStroke")
                glow.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 255)
                glow.Thickness = 1.5
                glow.Transparency = 1
                glow.Parent = eye

                local inner = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = eye,
                    Size = UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0.35, 0),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.12, 0, 0.10, 0),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ZIndex = eyeZIndex + 1,
                })
                local uc2 = Instance.new("UICorner")
                uc2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
                uc2.Parent = inner

                return eye, glow, inner
            end

            local eyeL, glowL, innerL = makeEye(eyeData.X1 or 0.36, eyeData.Y1 or 0.47)
            local eyeR, glowR, innerR = makeEye(eyeData.X2 or 0.64, eyeData.Y2 or 0.47)

            table.insert(logoLayers, {
                label = eyeL,
                def   = { Movement = "None" },
                state = { angle=0, speed=0, tSpeed=0, time=0, turboEndTime=0, turboSpeed=0 },
            })
            table.insert(logoLayers, {
                label = eyeR,
                def   = { Movement = "None" },
                state = { angle=0, speed=0, tSpeed=0, time=0, turboEndTime=0, turboSpeed=0 },
            })

            local function setEyes(alpha, duration)
                local dur = duration or 0.12
                local neonAlpha = alpha > 0.5 and 1 or 0.55
                TweenService:Create(eyeL,  TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {BackgroundTransparency = alpha}):Play()
                TweenService:Create(eyeR,  TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {BackgroundTransparency = alpha}):Play()
                TweenService:Create(glowL, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Transparency = neonAlpha}):Play()
                TweenService:Create(glowR, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Transparency = neonAlpha}):Play()
                TweenService:Create(innerL,TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {BackgroundTransparency = alpha}):Play()
                TweenService:Create(innerR,TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {BackgroundTransparency = alpha}):Play()
            end

            local eyesOpen = false
            local function openEyesCycle(holdTime, onDone)
                if not eyeL.Parent then if onDone then onDone() end return end
                if eyesOpen then if onDone then onDone() end return end
                eyesOpen = true
                setEyes(0, 2.0)
                task.delay(2.0 + holdTime, function()
                    if not eyeL.Parent then eyesOpen = false if onDone then onDone() end return end
                    setEyes(1, 0.25)
                    task.delay(0.25, function()
                        eyesOpen = false
                        if onDone then onDone() end
                    end)
                end)
            end

            local looping = true
            local function eyeLoop()
                if not eyeL.Parent or not looping then return end
                task.delay(6, function()
                    if not eyeL.Parent or not looping then return end
                    openEyesCycle(2.0, function()
                        task.delay(6, function()
                            eyeLoop()
                        end)
                    end)
                end)
            end

            eyeLoop()

            toggleEyesOnClick = function()
                openEyesCycle(3.0, nil)
            end

            local eyeConn
            eyeConn = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if not eyeL.Parent then
                    looping = false
                    toggleEyesOnClick = nil
                    eyeConn:Disconnect()
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    ApplyLogoIcon(SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon or "ClassicYinYang")

    local ToggleScale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, ToggleButton)

    local capsuleLastRelX = 0

    ToggleButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            capsuleLastRelX = input.Position.X - ToggleButton.AbsolutePosition.X
            if not ToggleButton:GetAttribute("IsCapsule") then
                TweenService:Create(ToggleScale, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 0.88}):Play()
            end
        end
    end)
    ToggleButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            if not ToggleButton:GetAttribute("IsCapsule") then
                TweenService:Create(ToggleScale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
            end
        end
    end)

    local shownSize = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 340)
    local ShadowFrame = mk("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.98,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = 4,
        Parent = ScreenGui
    })
    corner(ShadowFrame, 10)
    ShadowFrame:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Stroke")

    local Main = mk("Frame", {
        Name = "Main",
        Size = shownSize,
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ClipsDescendants = true,
        Visible = true,
        ZIndex = 5
    }, ScreenGui)
    Main:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
    corner(Main, 10)
    stroke(Main, Theme.Border, 1.5)

    local MainScale = mk("UIScale", {
        Scale = 1,
    }, Main)

    buildAnimatedBorder(Main, Theme.Border, UDim.new(0, 10))

    local BackgroundArt
    local TopBarArt
    local TabListArt

    local function updateShadowPos()
        ShadowFrame.Size = UDim2.new(Main.Size.X.Scale, Main.Size.X.Offset + 4, Main.Size.Y.Scale, Main.Size.Y.Offset + 4)
        ShadowFrame.Position = UDim2.new(Main.Position.X.Scale, Main.Position.X.Offset - 2, Main.Position.Y.Scale, Main.Position.Y.Offset - 2)
    end
    Main:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(updateShadowPos)
    Main:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(updateShadowPos)
    updateShadowPos()

    local uiVisible = true
    local windowTweenBusy = false
    local activeWindowTween = nil

    local function pauseMainGlowOnly(key)
        local tweens = ActiveGlowTweens[key]
        if tweens then
            for _, tw in ipairs(tweens) do
                pcall(function() tw:Cancel() end)
            end
        end
    end

    local function setMainGlowEnabled(enabled)
        local key = tostring(Main)
        if enabled then
            local tweens = ActiveGlowTweens[key]
            if tweens then
                for _, tw in ipairs(tweens) do
                    pcall(function() tw:Play() end)
                end
            else
                buildAnimatedBorder(Main, Theme.Border, UDim.new(0, 10))
            end
        else
            pauseMainGlowOnly(key)
        end
    end

    local function showMainWindow()
        if windowTweenBusy or uiVisible then
            return
        end

        windowTweenBusy = true
        uiVisible = true

        if activeWindowTween then
            pcall(function()
                activeWindowTween:Cancel()
            end)
            activeWindowTween = nil
        end

        setMainGlowEnabled(true)
        ShadowFrame.Visible = false
        Main.Visible = true
        -- Evita recalcular el tamaño de todos los controles durante la apertura.
        MainScale.Scale = 1
        Main.BackgroundTransparency = 0

        local tw = TweenService:Create(
            MainScale,
            TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Scale = 1 }
        )
        activeWindowTween = tw
        tw:Play()
        tw.Completed:Once(function()
            if activeWindowTween == tw then
                activeWindowTween = nil
            end
            ShadowFrame.Visible = true
            windowTweenBusy = false
        end)

        local turboEnd = os.clock() + 4
        for _, entry in ipairs(logoLayers) do
            if entry.def.Movement == "Spin" then
                entry.state.turboEndTime = entry.def.TurboSeconds and (os.clock() + entry.def.TurboSeconds) or turboEnd
            end
        end
    end

    local function hideMainWindow()
        if windowTweenBusy or not uiVisible then
            return
        end

        windowTweenBusy = true
        uiVisible = false

        if activeWindowTween then
            pcall(function() activeWindowTween:Cancel() end)
            activeWindowTween = nil
        end

        ShadowFrame.Visible = false

        local tw1 = TweenService:Create(
            MainScale,
            TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
            { Scale = 1 }
        )
        local tw2 = TweenService:Create(
            Main,
            TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyl
